hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM backed by Euler Finance lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes pricing via a configurable invariant curve (CurveLib), deposits received tokens into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another vault, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to fully override pool execution — bypassing Uniswap's standard x*y=k pricing entirely.
